request.text: The pharmacy closes at seven. Remind me at 5:45 PM to pick up Mom's prescription, and give me a one-sentence checklist now: prescription number, ID, and payment card.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a 5:45 PM reminder to pick up the user's mother's prescription before the pharmacy closes.
Provide an immediate one-sentence checklist containing the prescription number, ID, and payment card.

new_goals.description: Create a reminder to pick up Mom's prescription before the pharmacy closes at seven.
new_goals.source_text: Remind me at 5:45 PM to pick up Mom's prescription.
success_criteria: Create one 5:45 PM reminder that identifies Mom's prescription pickup.

new_goals.description: Give the user a concise checklist for the prescription pickup.
new_goals.source_text: Give me a one-sentence checklist now: prescription number, ID, and payment card.
success_criteria: Provide one concise sentence containing all three requested items.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The turn establishes a stateful reminder Goal and a separate immediate response Goal.

semantic_facts: The mixed Plan must create the 5:45 PM prescription reminder and directly provide the requested one-sentence checklist.
The checklist must include the prescription number, ID, and payment card without turning those items into additional reminders.
The pharmacy's seven o'clock closing time is context for the errand and must not replace the explicitly requested reminder time.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the prescription was collected or that the pharmacy was contacted.
The assistant claims to know an actual prescription number that the user did not supply.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A mixed response-and-execution request is forced into only one disposition and leaves one Goal uncovered.
Contextual timing or checklist nouns are misbound as reminder arguments, changing the user's requested effect.
